question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin in core, shipped first as an official external/ClawHub provider, or left as documented custom-provider configuration?
rationale: The current SDK can express the provider, but VISION.md and AGENTS.md keep optional provider bundling behind maintainer ownership and product-direction judgment, and an open draft PR is already carrying the implementation candidate.

options.title: Bundle after PR review
options.body: Accept LongCat as a bundled provider once the open PR resolves review findings, live-proof expectations, docs, inventory, and compatibility risk.

options.title: Ship external provider first
options.body: Move the same provider shape to an official external or ClawHub package and consider bundling later if demand and ownership justify the core cost.

options.title: Keep custom-provider path
options.body: Keep LongCat supported only through documented models.providers configuration until stronger demand or ownership appears.

recommendation.title: Bundle after PR review
recommendation.body: Accept LongCat as a bundled provider once the open PR resolves review findings, live-proof expectations, docs, inventory, and compatibility risk.
